components.name: Weights
components.explanation: Exact remote file size of the Q4_K_M variant.

components.name: KV cache
components.explanation: 22 layers x 4 KV heads x 64 head_dim x 2048 tokens x batch 1 x 2 bytes x 1 sessions x 2.

components.name: Runtime overhead
components.explanation: Base 0.50 GiB + 10% of weights (0.06 GiB). CPU allowance, not GPU calibration. CPU repacking is runtime-dependent and is not separately sized; this heuristic is not an upper bound.

runtime_overhead_components.name: CPU compute allowance
runtime_overhead_components.explanation: 0.25 GiB heuristic; actual compute buffers depend on token batching.

runtime_overhead_components.name: Other CPU runtime allowance
runtime_overhead_components.explanation: Remaining general runtime heuristic; not a measured allocation.

runtime_overhead_components.name: CPU repacking
runtime_overhead_components.explanation: Depends on tensor types, CPU kernels and runtime build. Not separately added to the heuristic total.

kv_cache.formula: kv_bytes = 2 * num_layers * num_kv_heads * head_dim * context * batch * concurrent_users * bytes_per_kv_element
notes: Grouped-Query Attention: 4 KV heads for 32 attention heads.

reasons: CPU consumption is checked separately from the desired RAM reserve and margin.

assumptions: Base model resolved to TinyLlama/TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0 via model_card_metadata.
KV cache dtype assumed to be float16.
GGUF CPU headroom: 512 MiB of RAM; the GPU's 1 GiB minimum does not apply.
No automatic percentage margin is added to GGUF headroom.
warnings: Repository contains 12 GGUF artifact representations (Q2_K, Q3_K_L, Q3_K_M, Q3_K_S, Q4_0, Q4_K_M, Q4_K_S, Q5_0, Q5_K_M, Q5_K_S, Q6_K, Q8_0); only one is loaded at a time.
GGUF header read up to its tokenizer; every key the memory estimate reads was present, the rest was not fetched.
Grouped-Query Attention: 4 KV heads for 32 attention heads.
CPU overhead uses a general 512 MiB + 10% of weights heuristic, not the GPU compute-buffer calibration. CPU repacking is not separately sized and can exceed this allowance.
